name: Telegram bots
description: Lists the Telegram bots the caller may use — those configured to act as the caller's identity (all bots for the venue identity) — with their routing target, state (STARTING, PENDING, RUNNING, STOPPED), Telegram username once validated, last error when pending, and message counters. Bot tokens are never returned.

managed.description: Declared in venue config, or created at runtime with telegram:create

error.description: Why the bot is not running, when PENDING
